rv.q: There's much to cherish here, but a tighter focus might enable a deeper dive into the complex secrets that are churning through this family and their community.
Sensitively discussing themes of grief, family and community, this slow-burning drama satisfyingly blends humour, heart and melancholy.
Heart Wall is poignant and thought-provoking: with a tighter focus, it could deliver even more impact.
It all needs a stronger pulse and bloodflow to make for compelling drama.
A triumph – warm, witty, and deeply human.
In this brilliantly funny, well-paced production, seamlessly directed by Katie Greenall, we are teleported into the heart of a Manc family and community.
All in all, Heart Wall is alright, but could be better.
